subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Finally, the music club chose quieter songs and played them at a lower volume.”?
options: Students liked the clock because it made them feel less late.
Teachers checked the map for accuracy, and students drew small pictures to make it friendly.
They found three problems: unclear signs, noisy lines, and students who did not know where to stand.
The goal was not to make students listen, but to make the room feel less noisy.
